movement_profile.footwork: stamping feet with ankle bells (chilanka) attached to leather pads below knees for men or around ankles for women
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Proscenium-style temple court performance facing the sanctum sanctorum
movement_profile.partnering: Ensemble performance consisting entirely of men and young boys portraying both male and female roles
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Do not treat headgear or costume non-devotionally; sacred rituals and prayer before an oil lamp must precede performance.

music_profile.musical_form: Sanskrit text structured into eight dramatic plays (chapters)
music_profile.sound_description: Resonant vocal recitation of Sanskrit slokas accompanied by rhythmic Madhalam drumming, creating a solemn, sacred atmosphere suited for nocturnal temple ritual.

teaching.formation: Nocturnal ritual theater facing the temple lamp and sanctum sanctorum
teaching.level_notes: Requires intense early training starting as early as age 5 for percussion/chutti makeup and age 10 for performance roles.
teaching.rhythm: Accompanying Sanskrit slokas and padyageethams backed by Madhalam drumming
